title: feat(cloud-connection): a same-origin read of the control plane's default install namespace
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB1tBW79GqioDEpaUFQASeqM)_

Fixes #32083

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/cloud-connection` 新增一条同源只读路由 `GET /api/v1/cloud-connection/install-namespace?package_id=PACKAGE_ID`，按主机名解析环境，用服务凭证向控制面读取非托管副本的默认命名空间，原样带回。
- 为什么改：托管环境的安装对话框（#32040）要把默认命名空间填进可编辑输入框，但控制面接口跨域、租户控制台也不知道自己的环境 id，读不到。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一条读路由，不改任何已有路由的行为；门禁与 `POST /install` 相同（本环境的登录会话，被策略挂起的会话拒绝）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts`（新路由的处理函数，紧挨 `/installation`）、`cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts`（新台账行）、`cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts`（末尾的拒绝与保真 pins）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 `[#32083]` 一组 9 个用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One read-only route beside `/installation`, named as the card suggested so #32040 follows it unchanged:

`GET /api/v1/cloud-connection/install-namespace?package_id=PACKAGE_ID`

- **Closed query set (AGENTS.md route rule 5).** `INSTALL_NAMESPACE_QUERY_PARAMS = ['package_id']`, measured from the handler's one read point. Recognition runs first, then arity, both the nested ADR-0112 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` through `@objectstack/rest`'s `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` / `repeatedQueryParamMessage`, before anything else is read. The `packageId` alias `/installation` honours is deliberately not taken (a new door takes one spelling), and an `environment_id` the caller names is refused: the environment is the request's host, never caller input.
- **Gate, the same as `POST /install`.** `resolveEnvironmentId` (hostname via `env-registry`, or the single-environment config) → `404 ENVIRONMENT_NOT_FOUND`; `resolveSession` → a held session refused by `refuseHeldSession` (`403`, the gate's own code), no session `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. Nothing reaches the control plane before these pass.
- **The control plane's answer, unchanged.** `GET {cloudUrl}/api/v1/cloud/packages/:id/install-namespace?environment_id=ENV` with the env→cloud credential (`authHeaders()`, the one `/install` presents); its status and JSON body are relayed as they came. Not connected → `503 CLOUD_UNCONFIGURED`; unreachable or a non-JSON answer → `502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR`. Neither carries a namespace, so the dialog reads "no default" and leaves the field empty; the route never answers a value it made up.
- **Ledger.** A `server-only` row in `cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts` (the conformance guard's exact accounting picks it up from the mount call); the scope paragraph and the `unbind` row's header-count note are brought up to the new totals.
- **Census pins.** `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts` (mounting: 9 routes) and `cloud-connection-auth-gate.pin.test.ts` (the new door joins `CC_SESSION_DOORS`, so it is held to HELD `403` under both modes, UN-HELD `200` in both credential shapes, and anonymous `401`).

## Why

#32040's hosted install dialog must show the default namespace the control plane will use for an unmanaged copy. The control plane answers it (cloud PR #4206), but cross-origin, and a tenant console has no environment id to ask with. This package already resolves the environment per request and proxies credentialed control-plane reads for the marketplace, so the read belongs here.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared harness `cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts`:

| Pin | Kind | Asserts |
|:--|:--|:--|
| unknown parameter (`packageId`, `environment_id`, a typo) | refusal | `400` + `VALIDATION_ERROR`, fetch never called |
| `package_id` twice | refusal | `400` + `VALIDATION_ERROR`, fetch never called |
| no session | refusal | `401` + `UNAUTHENTICATED`, fetch never called |
| host resolves to no environment | refusal | `404` + `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_FOUND`, fetch never called |
| missing / blank `package_id` | refusal | `400` + `INVALID_REQUEST`, fetch never called |
| unbound runtime | refusal | `503` + `CLOUD_UNCONFIGURED`, no `data`, fetch never called |
| control plane unreachable | refusal | `502` + `EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR`, no `data` |
| happy path | preservation | the URL the control plane received (encoded package id, this host's environment), `Authorization: Bearer SERVICE_KEY`, body deep-equal to the control plane's |
| control-plane refusal | preservation | its `404` status and body relayed unchanged |

Held sessions are pinned through `cloud-connection-auth-gate.pin.test.ts` (both postures × both modes). `error-envelope.conformance.test.ts` adds three cases holding the door's own `400` / `503` / `502` bodies to `BaseResponseSchema`, `envelopeViolations` and `ApiErrorSchema` (closed code vocabulary); its `driveCloudConnection` helper gains an optional `query`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cloud fact not read here.** This lane does not read cloud code, so the shape of the control plane's `install-namespace` answer (the key that carries the namespace inside `data`) is not measured from this repo. The route relays the body unchanged, so #32040 reads the key the control plane sends; the preservation pin's body is an illustrative fixture, not a claim about that shape.
- A control-plane refusal (any non-2xx with a JSON body) is relayed with its own status, the way `POST /install` relays one.

## Verification

All readings on `dea8eae6` (the final head; `b942df61` merged `origin/main` `0f7389cc`, and `dea8eae6` changes only the changeset's placeholder spelling).

- **Package suite.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test` after the merge and the closure rebuild: exit 0, `Test Files 80 passed (80)`, `Tests 1190 passed (1190)`.
- **Lint.** Root eslint over the touched package, `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/cloud-connection --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed 69 commands; each ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, exit code recorded before any pipe. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. The first round (on `82e79459`) found one red, `check:test-source-alias` on the edited envelope suite (a lazy `@objectstack/runtime` import reached inside a clocked case); fixed with a module-top side-effect import, the way the package's other suites do it.
- **Ablations.** Ten one-shot mutations of `cloud-connection-plugin.ts` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once, disk-verified write, restore to the `HEAD` blob), each running the three suites under the lock. Every leg went red, and `git diff HEAD` was empty after each restore. The suites import the plugin from `src/`, so no `dist/` sits between mutation and reading.

<details><summary>Ablation legs (mutation → tests that went red)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | unknown-parameter refusal deleted | closed-set pin; envelope `400` case |
| A2 | arity refusal disabled | `package_id` twice pin |
| A3 | environment refusal deleted | unresolved-host `404` pin |
| A4 | held-session refusal deleted | auth-gate HELD × 4 (both postures × both modes) |
| A5 | no-session refusal deleted | no-session `401` pin; auth-gate anonymous |
| A6 | blank `package_id` refusal deleted | missing/blank `400` pin |
| A7 | unbound refusal disabled | unbound `503` pin; envelope `503` case |
| A8 | unreachable answers a guessed namespace | unreachable `502` pin; envelope `502` case |
| A9 | relay sends `200` instead of the control plane's status | refusal-relay preservation pin |
| A10 | `environment_id` not sent upstream | happy-path preservation pin |

</details>

- **Size.** 6 files, under the 3,000 changed-line threshold (`dispatch-gates` change-set line).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (root eslint over `packages/cloud-connection`: exit 0)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
